headword: {機能|きのう}{障害|しょうがい}

definitions.explanation: A condition in which an organ or part of the body does not work as it should.

examples.japanese: {肝|かん}{機能|きのう}{障害|しょうがい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{診断|しんだん}→診断：04209_shindan⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was diagnosed with liver dysfunction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後遺症|こういしょう}→後遺症：08622_kouishou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{機能|きのう}{障害|しょうがい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}った→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: The accident left her with impaired function in one hand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{脳|のう}→脳：03537_nou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{傷|きず}つく→傷つく：01934_kizutsuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧や⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{機能|きのう}{障害|しょうがい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: When part of the brain is damaged, language or memory can become impaired.

notes:
USAGE:
A medical term, often joined to the organ: {肝|かん}{機能|きのう}{障害|しょうがい} (liver dysfunction), {腎|じん}{機能|きのう}{障害|しょうがい} (kidney dysfunction).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {機能|きのう}{障害|しょうがい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧: to be left with an impairment
- {機能|きのう}{障害|しょうがい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧: to cause dysfunction

WATCH OUT:
⟦{障害|しょうがい}→障害：03228_shougai⟧ on its own can also mean a disability or an obstacle; {機能|きのう}{障害|しょうがい} is specifically about a body part not working properly.
